title: Halal Cart Chicken and Rice
description: NYC cart energy at home — charred spiced thighs, turmeric rice, and that iconic white sauce.

items.name: white sauce, red hot sauce, parsley

steps: Marinate chicken with oil, vinegar, lemon & spices 20 min, then sear until charred and cooked through.
Toast rice with oil, butter, turmeric & spices, add stock, simmer covered 15 min until fluffy.
Whisk mayo, sour cream, lemon, garlic, salt & pepper; chill to thicken.
Pile rice, top with chicken, drizzle both sauces, scatter parsley.
notes: Char on the chicken is the whole point — don't crowd the pan.

title: High-Protein Tomato Basil Soup
description: Shred Happens style — roasted veg blended with bone broth and cottage cheese. ~79g protein total.
steps: Sheet pan tomatoes, onion, pepper, garlic with oil + spices.
Roast at 400°F for 60 min till caramelized and tender.
Blend roasted veg with bone broth + cottage cheese + basil till smooth and creamy.
Bowl it up — oil/cream drizzle, fresh basil, parmesan optional.
notes: Roast until deeply caramelized — pale veg = flat soup.

title: Spaghetti Carbonara
description: Real Roman carbonara — no cream. Guanciale, tempered eggs, Pecorino silk.
steps: Bring a large pot of heavily salted water to a rolling boil.
Cut guanciale into lardons. Render in a cold pan over medium-low ~8 min until crispy at edges. Keep warm off heat.
Whisk eggs, yolks, and most of the cheese. Season hard with black pepper.
Cook spaghetti until 90 seconds shy of al dente. Reserve 1 cup pasta water.
Toss drained pasta in guanciale fat off heat.
Pour egg mixture over pasta, tossing constantly. Splash pasta water until glossy. Don't scramble.
Plate warm. Finish with cheese and pepper.
notes: Off-heat is non-negotiable. Residual heat finishes the eggs.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
description: Char-edged tikka in a silky tomato-cream masala built on toasted spices.
ingredients: Marinade: 180g yogurt, 2 tsp garam masala, 1½ tsp cumin, 1 tsp turmeric, 1 tsp Kashmiri chili, 1 tsp salt, 2 tbsp oil
3 tbsp ghee, 1 large onion finely diced
2 tsp cumin seeds, 1 tsp coriander seeds (toasted, ground)
1 tsp turmeric, 2 tsp garam masala, 1½ tsp Kashmiri chili
steps: Marinate chicken min 4 hours (overnight best).
Broil/grill until deeply charred, 8–10 min per side.
Ghee + cumin seeds 30 sec. Onion 12–15 min until deep gold.
Garlic + ginger 2 min. Ground spices 1 min.
Tomatoes 15 min uncovered until oil separates.
Add chicken + cream. Simmer 8 min. Cilantro finish.
notes: Char is flavor — don't skip the broil.

title: Shakshuka
description: Eggs poached in spiced tomato-pepper sauce. One pan, celebratory Tuesday energy.
ingredients: 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika, ½ tsp caraway, pinch cayenne
steps: Onion + pepper in oil, 8 min until soft.
Garlic + spices 1–2 min.
Tomatoes + sugar, simmer 10 min until thick.
Make wells, crack eggs in.
Cover 5–8 min until whites just set, yolks runny.
Feta, parsley, olive oil. Serve from the pan.
notes: Pull when whites look barely set — residual heat finishes them.
